I had booked a grooming appointment for my cat and paid a 100 booking fee in advance. Unfortunately, my cat fell ill on the day of the appointment and I had to rush to the vet. I even had a valid doctor’s prescription and was ready to share proof, yet the staff refused to either refund or even reschedule the appointment. On top of that, booking appointments with them is unnecessarily difficult. They are extremely rigid with timings and never make any effort to accommodate customer preferences or help find suitable slots. It always feels like customers are expected to adjust entirely according to their convenience, with zero flexibility from their side.

For a business dealing with pets and pet parents, basic understanding and customer service should be expected — sadly, that is completely missing here. Definitely not an experience I would recommend.
